gs12b-048.q: The cost function C(x) = x³ − 6x² + 15x models production costs. What output x minimizes cost?
gs12b-048.n: C′(x) = 3(x − 2)² + 3 is always positive, so the cost keeps rising with output and has no turning point. The show's x = 2 is where the marginal cost C′(x) is lowest.
